Manage execution resources

Usage:
  inframill command execution [flags]
  inframill command execution [command]

Available Commands:
  get         GetCommandExecution through the daemon
  list        ListCommandExecutions through the daemon
  stderr      ReadCommandLog through the daemon
  stdout      ReadCommandLog through the daemon
  wait        GetCommandExecution through the daemon

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for execution

Global Flags:
      --color string      human output color: auto, always or never (default "auto")
      --config string     optional CLI defaults YAML; explicit files are required (default ".inframill.yaml")
      --endpoint string   daemon HTTP(S) base URL (default "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
  -o, --output string     output format: table or json (logs: json only) (default "table")
      --timeout string    total invocation deadline (default "2m")

Use "inframill command execution [command] --help" for more information about a command.
